September 18, 1971
2014-12-12T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/september-18-1971-54691

150 representatives from 24 different countries gather at New Delhi to attend an international conference to discuss Bangladesh matter. All 24 countries support Bangladesh’s cause. They welcome India for sheltering the Bangladeshi refugees. They also promise help for Bangladesh.

Ghulam Azam welcomes the new cabinet. He congratulates them as they ‘take’ risk in such a moment.

PDP chief Nurul Amin and PPP chief Zulfikar Ali Bhutto meet with President Yahya separately in Karachi.
